svg.title: A 11-year tree, 5792 commits, 3 ripening persimmons, 7 lanterns for code reviews.
svg.desc: A bonsai grown from the public GitHub history of veteran, drawn for 2026-07-15. Season: summer. Maturity level 7 of 13, in a stone pot. Every element is recomputable from public history; nothing here is random or purchasable.
